newsitem.title: USA: State Street cannot explain imbalance.
newsitem.headline: State Street cannot explain imbalance.

text.p: State Street Corp said Thursday it was not aware of anything that would have caused its stock to be halted for a trading imbalance this morning.
Traders and analysts attributed the activity in the stock to takeover speculation.
"We don't have any news here that would have caused the trading imbalance," a State Street spokeswoman said.
After the halt, the stock jumped more than four points. It was up 3-5/8 at 53-1/2 in afternoon trading.
Earlier this afternoon the company announced an increase in its quarterly dividend, to $0.11 per share from $0.10.
